The '''Salmagodro system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Salmagodro Grand Academy]].<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Salmagodro [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
